privateDeals.what: Sold Volga Shipping (Sea of Azov/Black Sea bulk carrier operator, >15m t/yr cargo) to companies affiliated with agricultural logistics group Demetra; value undisclosed (Reuters)

realEstate.type: 17th-century castle and sporting estate (Aberuchill); older holding

trophies.what: Lisya Nora shooting complex near Moscow, described as one of Europe's largest shooting-range complexes; former ISSF president (2018-2022)

policy.what: Sanctioned by Australia (Russia sanctions framework; OpenSanctions lists 2022-04-06) and by Canada (listed June 2025 under Special Economic Measures Act); on Ukraine NSDC sanctions register since 2022-10-19. Not sanctioned by US/UK/EU per available reporting.

Ukraine pushing EU to add Lisin (and Potanin) to next batch of individual sanctions; his spokesperson says neither he nor NLMK cooperate with Russia's military-industrial complex. NLMK has plants in Belgium, France, Italy and Denmark.

watch.what: Whether EU adds Lisin/NLMK to its next Russia sanctions batch (Ukraine lobbying, reported 2026-09-24); exposure of NLMK's EU plants
NLMK earnings: H1 2026 IFRS net profit fell 45.6% y/y to RUB 20.5bn; watch Q3/9M results and any dividend decision
